metadata.title: BiteDoneRight: eat right, train right
metadata.description: Find recipes from what is in your fridge, with nutrition and portions sized to your own goals.

welcome.body: Your InBody results become a meal plan, a training programme and a monthly progress report, all made for your body.
welcome.sameButton: New here or coming back, it's the same button.
welcome.trial: Everything is free for your first 30 days.

profile.intro: Your Nutritionist uses these details to work out your daily calories, protein, carbs and fat. You can change or delete them at any time.
profile.birthYearHint: Targets are designed for adults aged 18 to 80.
profile.sexHint: The formula uses it: energy needs differ between female and male bodies.

how.title: How we worked this out
how.bmrMeasured: At rest your body burns {bmr, number, latn} kcal a day, as your InBody measured on {date}.

goal.lose_fat: To lose fat, you eat about 20% less: {target, number, latn} kcal a day.

goal.gain_muscle: To build muscle, you eat about 10% more: {target, number, latn} kcal a day.

how.protein: Protein: {perKg, number, latn} g for each kg of body weight, then fat at a quarter to a third of calories and carbs for the rest.
how.fibre: Fibre: 14 g for every 1,000 calories you eat.
how.water: Water: 35 ml for each kg of body weight, plus half a litre on days you train.

scan.title: Upload your InBody results
scan.intro: Add a new scan each month. Your targets, water and meals update as soon as you save it.
scan.photoBody: Take a clear, straight photo of the whole result sheet in good light. It's read on your phone and never uploaded.
scan.readDone: We read {found, plural, one {{found, number, latn} number} other {{found, number, latn} numbers}} off your sheet. Check each one against it, fill in anything missing, then save.

readErrors.signed_out: You've been signed out. Sign in again to read a photo.

readErrors.unreadable: We couldn't read the numbers on that photo. Try a sharper photo or type them below.
readErrors.refused: We couldn't read that photo. Type the numbers from your sheet below.
readErrors.upstream: Reading failed. Try again in a moment, or type the numbers below.

burn.title: BurnToReturn

burn.signedOutBody: Sign in for your own training programme: calisthenics, pilates, gym or CrossFit, built around your goal, with how to do every exercise and what to avoid.
burn.lockedBody: A training programme for your goal and your week, with clear form cues and the mistakes to avoid for every exercise.
burn.noProfileBody: Your goal and activity shape your programme: more sets to build muscle, shorter rests to burn fat. It takes a minute.

calisthenics.name: Calisthenics
calisthenics.blurb: Your body weight, anywhere. Floor space and a sturdy table.

pilates.name: Pilates
pilates.blurb: Slow, controlled mat work for core, posture and glutes. A mat is enough.

gym.name: Gym
gym.blurb: Machines, dumbbells and barbells, with weights you build up week by week.

crossfit.name: CrossFit
crossfit.blurb: Short, intense mixed workouts. Kettlebell, box, rower and a pull-up bar.
